It cuts 'keyword-DM automation flows' as ops and has no Launch module. This contradicts two founder decisions: comment-keyword CTAs ON by default, each with its matching auto-reply/DM script; and planned 7/14/21-day launch campaigns with a 'launch mode' for the weekly automation.

The ChatGPT automation puts BATCH, REVIEW, DROP, the Brief, the Season and the Ship Check into one task prompt of ≤8,000 chars. ChatGPT's task-prompt limit is undocumented, and weekday recurrence on Free is unverified. The 3-task split is offered only 'on request', yet it is the safer default.

VN Notion and Sheet property names are localised through a label map. The research recommends English property names in both editions, so one set of prompts works for both. Localised names add a way for connector writes to fail silently in the VN edition only.

The Gemini path never says where the Brand Brain lives between chats (no Project, no hub writes). A Gemini coach loses all context in the second session unless told to attach MY-BRAND-BRAIN.md every time.

The ChatGPT install relies on founder-maintained task share links. These carry the founder's time zone, so the coach must fix it. The coach also pastes the Brief into the <<BRIEF>> slot of 3 tasks, re-pastes it monthly, and does a Notion 'Merge with CSV'. A non-technical coach will get at least one of these wrong, which leaves the Brief out of date in the tasks or runs them at the wrong hour.

There are about 35 coach-visible items per edition, 15 commands, and a 6-step Claude install (Notion + connector + Skill + Project + tasks). The weekly load is about 9 assets plus 8 stats per post entered at day 7. That assumes a VA, so a solo coach with 1-2 h/week is overloaded.
It has no Launch module (only a 'launch' phase mix) and no Character Core or Character & Polarity Edge pillar. Both are founder additions.
Path B states that 'connectors and Skills work on Free' as fact, but the vendor docs conflict on this, and there is no fallback if Skills are missing. Gemini gets no automation path at all.
'Keyword in 100% of pieces' conflicts with the proposal's own variation guard. It also risks forced, repetitive phrasing, the 'mass-produced' pattern that platforms demote.

Path A asks the coach to choose between uploading a plugin or a skill. Installing both duplicates the skill and causes trigger conflicts. Path A also has 6 steps, and the coach creates 3 scheduled tasks by hand. The pack is about 60 files across 5 install paths plus automation, hub, examples and WHATS-NEW folders, so the coach makes several decisions before getting any value.

The v1 build scope is very large: a custom renderer, translation memory with paragraph hashes, schema migrations, an 'update check' command, a plugin, an all-in-one Lite file, and eval adapters for 3 vendors with calibrated LLM judges. A greenfield v1 risks never shipping.

Fast mode (one voice note) is the default only on free tiers. Paid coaches get one question at a time with probes, and the Film Today script arrives at about minute 26–36, after the 30-day calendar is built. That delays the first win compared with the other proposals.
